goal: An owner can find out what any headline dashboard number means without leaving the page, through one shared affordance that works with a mouse, a keyboard and a touch screen.
non_goals: A tip on every element — the rule is that a number needing a tip may instead need a better label
Fixing chart readability, which is #1088's ticket; a missing unit is a label change there, not a tooltip here
Any change to what the dashboard computes or how it buckets — the KPI fragments are ADR 0019's, untouched
A tour, a walkthrough, or dismissible onboarding state
user_visible_behavior: A tip affordance sits beside the headline of each covered surface and reveals a short explanation.
The explanation opens on hover AND on click or tap, so it is reachable without a pointer.
It is reachable by keyboard and dismissible with Escape.
The explanation is associated with the element it describes for assistive tech.
invariants: The affordance works below 768px, where there is no hover.
No surface that already mounts a LiveRegion has that region's tree position changed.
Console tokens only — no new colours, no ad-hoc inline styles where a token exists.
No component is pushed back over the complexity gate by adding a tip.
edge_cases: Touch device: hover never fires, so tap must open and an outside tap must close.
Keyboard: focus reaches the trigger and Escape closes without moving focus somewhere surprising.
Reduced motion: any reveal animation is suppressed.
Aggregate location scope renders a different card set than per-location; both need covering or a stated reason.
A tip whose text is longer than its container must not clip at 390px.
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/components/ui/LiveRegion.tsx — the repo's only a11y primitive in that folder, and the announcement contract to avoid disturbing
src/components/dashboard/kpi/ChartHeadlineBanner.tsx — the existing way a surface already states what it means, and the cheaper alternative to a tip
tests_to_add: the tip opens on click as well as hover, so a touch device can reach it
the tip is reachable by keyboard and closes on Escape
the tip is associated with the element it describes
every covered surface names what its number means
adding a tip does not move an existing LiveRegion in the tree
rollback_plan: Revert the squash commit. Presentation only — no schema, no flag, no computation change.
